rv.q: Zhailon Levingston’s high-energy staging and standout performances by Saycon Sengbloh and Brittany Campbell cannot overcome blurry acting, murky sound and a weakened emotional journey.
The Playhouse’s production is a super-charged evening of sex, drugs and introspection and discovery, not particularly in that order.
The Pasadena Playhouse’s production of Passing Strange is an astonishing achievement.
I just wish I loved it as much as the opening night audience so obviously did.

cn.t: Critics largely praise this exuberant rock musical's irreverent energy and autobiographical storytelling, though some find it doesn't fully connect. Strong performances and Stew's bold vision earn acclaim despite mixed reactions.
